meta.name: debugging
meta.description: Systematic debugging methodology. Use when encountering unexpected behavior, test failures, or production issues. Covers reproduce-isolate-fix-verify cycle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按系统方法定位并修复软件故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常靠瞎猜来找代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Fix software issues by reproducing, isolating, and verifying
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often rely on guesswork when something goes wrong in your code

howto.what: Claude 会按一套系统化调试流程处理问题：先复现，再用二分查找等方法缩小范围、找出根因，做最小修复并验证；全程凭证据不靠猜。
howto.when: 当遇到测试失败、意外行为或性能回退等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试这个报错，先复现再定位根因。
say.note: Claude 会先复现问题，再逐步定位根因。

say.text: 用二分查找法找出是哪个改动引入的 bug。
这个功能时好时坏，帮我查下是不是竞态条件。
say.note: 针对间歇性问题，Claude 会检查并发与共享状态。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow a systematic debugging workflow: reproduce the issue, narrow it down with binary search, find the root cause, apply a minimal fix, and verify—all based on evidence, not guesses.
howto.when_en: Triggers on test failures, unexpected behavior, performance regressions, and similar issues.

say_en.text: Debug this error: reproduce first, then find the root cause.
Use binary search to find which change introduced this bug.
say_en.note: Claude may use git bisect to locate the commit.

say_en.text: This feature works intermittently—check for race conditions.
say_en.note: Claude examines concurrency and shared state.
